title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Gentle and Still Hold the Line
caption:
Gentle is a tone. It isn't a surrender.

A godly man can lower his voice and still say no. He names the behavior, not the person, and stays at the table afterward.

Save this for the next hard conversation.

#faith #gentleness #godlyman #leadership
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
